guide.title: Stitches's Overview
guide.text:
Stitches is a Tank whose signature move is Hook,
a unique Ability that can be used to pull enemy Heroes from the distance
and allow allied Heroes to follow up with
crowd control and burst damage.

guide.title: Stitches's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Solid waveclear
Powerful high-range pull effect
High maximum Health
Good self-sustain
Decent damage
Weaknesses
Low crowd control
Lack of mobility
Weak peeling

guide.title: Stitches's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Stitches synergizes with
Stitches works well with Heroes who can quickly respond to any successful Hook
by locking the target enemy Hero in place with crowd control
(for example Malfurion with Entangling Roots)
and that have access to burst damage to get a kill
before the enemy team can react (such as Jaina).
To compensate his lack of peeling, Stitches likes to be in team
with Heroes that have access to crowd control.
We recommend an Offlaner who can act as a secondary
Tank during team fights (for example Blaze).
If your team has access to a disengage tool (such as
Mighty Gust), they can use it either to save you from danger
or to knock the rest of the enemy team away
right after you Hook someone.
Stitches is countered by
Because so much of Stitches's ability to impact a match is baked into Hook,
he can be challenged by frontline Heroes who are bad targets for it
as they may use Unstoppable on demand, put a Summon on the trajectory,
easily dodge the skillshot, or run away right after.
Heroes who can save the target right after they get caught are good counters as well.
Due to his high Health pool and lack of mobility,
Stitches is also susceptible to percent-based damage
(for example Leoric with Drain Hope
and Entomb).

guide.title: Stitches's Maps
guide.text:
Stitches's stronger maps
Stitches's average maps
Stitches's weaker maps
Stitches prefers Maps where Hook can easily be used
through impassable terrain
and/or near choke points while teams tend to group.
This way your team gets the opportunity to quickly take down an enemy Hero
before their team is able to respond.
The high amount of waveclear he provides makes
Stitches a good pick on 3-lane Maps where the metagame strategy is to rotate
between two lanes (for example Volskaya Foundry).
Due to his lack of mobility to escape himself
and peeling to protect the rest of his team, Stitches
does not like Maps where the enemy team can easily gank him
or flank his team before he can even get a chance to
use Hook from the distance.

guide.title: Stitches's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Hook can be used to interrupt any kind of channeling.
Helping Hand shares its cooldown with Hook, but it will be halved when hitting allied Heroes.
Slam is a great tool for dismounting enemy Heroes and for waveclearing.
Devour should not be used when Stitches has more than 80% of his maximum Health, else you will waste part of its effect, unless you want to use it to secure a kill.
Shambling Horror increases your Movement Speed, in addition to making it impossible to be reduced below that value.
Putrid Bile helps you to engage, peel, or disengage.
Gorge can be used to bring enemy Heroes behind your Gates, resulting in easy kills with the help of your Structures shooting at them.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Stitches's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Stitches prefers to be played as main Tank
in a burst composition,
so in a team that can provide both crowd control
and burst damage right after his Hook.
Due to his one-dimensional design, Stitches should not be drafted
too early in order to avoid that the enemy team will exploit
his lack of crowd control by picking
high-mobility Heroes.

abilities.title: Stitches's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Hook can be used to interrupt any kind of channeling.
Helping Hand shares its cooldown with Hook, but it will be halved when hitting allied Heroes.
Slam is a great tool for dismounting enemy Heroes and for waveclearing.
Devour should not be used when Stitches has more than 80% of his maximum Health, else you will waste part of its effect, unless you want to use it to secure a kill.
Shambling Horror increases your Movement Speed, in addition to making it impossible to be reduced below that value.
Putrid Bile helps you to engage, peel, or disengage.
Gorge can be used to bring enemy Heroes behind your Gates, resulting in easy kills with the help of your Structures shooting at them.

abilities.title: Hook
abilities.text:
Hook
(Q)
Stitches
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Pull the first enemy hit towards Stitches and deal 91 (+4% per level) damage.
After reaching level 13, Hook's range is increased by 40%.
Hook is a Basic Ability that allows Stitches
to briefly Stun and Displace
towards him the first enemy hit from high distance.
After reaching Level 13, you will automatically unlock extra range.
Use it to engage from range or to deny an enemy Hero their chance to flee.
Sometimes you can even use it from melee, just to briefly make the target unable to act.
If you manage to Hook an enemy Hero
and your team is ready to follow up
with crowd control and burst damage,
you may be able to get a kill before the real team fight even starts.
The brief Stun that happens when hitting enemies
with Hook allows Stitches to not only interrupt
stationary-channeled Abilities
(such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.)
but also mobile-channeled Abilities
(for example Jug of 1,000 Cups by Li Li).
While laning, you can occasionally use Hook
on enemy Mercenaries to Displace them within the range of your Structures,
a trick that is extremely useful against Mercenaries who can outrange Structures (for example Siege Giants).
Hook can Pull enemies through
impassable terrain (including player-created one)
and Invulnerable enemy Structures (for example Healing Fountains).
Note that Hook can only travel through allied Structures,
Invulnerable enemy Structures, and impassable terrain.
Hook and Helping Hand
share their cooldowns, meaning they will always go on cooldown together
and be available again at the exact same time.

abilities.title: Helping Hand
abilities.text:
Helping Hand
(1)
Stitches
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Activate to use Hook that can hit allied Heroes. Hitting an allied Hero this way reduces the cooldown of Hook by 8 seconds.
After reaching level 13, Helping Hand's range is increased by 40%.
Helping Hand is a Basic Ability that allows Stitches
to briefly Stun and Displace towards him
the first allied or enemy Hero hit from high distance.
After reaching Level 13, you will automatically unlock extra range.
Use it to save allied Heroes from danger, a play that is particularly strong
if you can manage to Pull them through impassable terrain. Remember that
any enemy Hero on the way will be a valid target, meaning that the enemy team
can stop you from saving someone by intercepting Helping Hand.
Avoid using it when they are channeling an Ability
because it will be interrupted
like when using Hook against enemy Heroes.
Helping Hand can Pull allies through
impassable terrain (including player-created one),
allied Structures, and Invulnerable enemy Structures (for example Healing Fountains).
Note that Helping Hand can only travel through allied Structures,
Invulnerable enemy Structures, and impassable terrain.
When you use Helping Hand,
Hook goes on cooldown as well.
If Helping Hand hits an allied Hero,
the cooldown of both these Basic Abilities will be halved.

abilities.title: Slam
abilities.text:
Slam
(W)
Stitches
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Deal 104 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area. Enemies in the inner impact take 50% more damage and are Slowed by 45% for 2 seconds.
Slam is a Basic Ability that deals moderate damage to all
enemies in a wide cone-shaped area in front of Stitches.
Enemies within the inner area take 50% additional damage and are Slowed.
Use it to Slow melee Heroes who are threatening your team
as they are easy to hit with the inner area that applies it.
The wide area covered by Slam makes it a great tool
for dismounting enemy Heroes, especially useful against enemy Tanks.

abilities.title: Devour
abilities.text:
Devour
(E)
Stitches
Mana: 55
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Deal 319 (+4% per level) damage to non-Heroic units, or 114 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes. Restores 20% of Stitches's maximum Health.
Devour is a Basic Ability that heals Stitches
for a huge chunk of his maximum Health and deals some damage to the chosen enemy,
almost tripled against non-Heroes.
While it deals damage, avoid using Devour
when full Health as you may find yourself in trouble a dozen of seconds later
and not have it available due to its moderately long cooldown.
On the other hand, do not wait to be extremely low on Health
because a well-timed crowd control
may stop you from casting any Ability until you die
and the short range will make it impossible to cast if kited.
In case of need, the increased damage to non-Heroes may be useful to quickly take down enemy Summons
(such as Summon Water Elemental by Jaina) while healing.

abilities.title: Putrid Bile
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Putrid Bile
(R)
Stitches
Heroic
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 75 seconds
Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.
Putrid Bile is a Heroic that,
for 8 seconds after being cast, allows Stitches to move at increased
Movement Speed and infect the terrain surrounding him.
The infected area will hit enemies once per second, dealing damage
and Slowing them for 1.5 seconds.
Each portion of infected area will stay that way for 4 seconds.
During Putrid Bile, you want to
place yourself along the path that enemy Heroes are most likely to take,
forcing them to move through the infected area if they wish to progress. This gives you
and the rest of your team time to position accordingly and/or deal damage to enemy Heroes affected.
The main characteristic of Putrid Bile is the
Slow component, something that partially makes up for
Stitches's lack of peeling.
Stitches does not have any mobility tool,
so the Movement Speed bonus he gets during Putrid Bile
can help him mitigate this weakness while trying to engage
or escape. In particular, you should not hesitate to use it just to survive.

abilities.title: Gorge
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Gorge
(R)
Stitches
Heroic
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 65 seconds
Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.
Gorge is a Heroic Ability that allows Stitches to
remove an enemy Hero from the battlefield for 4 seconds, move them around with him,
and then free them in front of him.
In particular, Gorge is a
Stasis effect that completely removes
the target enemy Hero from the battlefield for a few seconds,
therefore it does not allow them to eventually contest a Control Point
and it interrupts any Ability they are trying to cast,
unless they are Unstoppable
(for example Johanna with Iron Skin active).
Due to its low range, Gorge is usually cast
immediately after Hook. After that,
you should usually run towards your team so that they can focus
the enemy Hero that has been caught and/or behind your Gate so that they cannot
escape while attacked by Structures surrounding them.
Sometimes, when your team is ready to follow up
immediately after Hook connects on an enemy Hero,
the correct play is to not use Gorge to avoid delaying
the kill by 4 seconds or, even worse, give the enemy team enough time to save them.
Since Gorge will always expel the consumed Hero
directly in front of Stitches,
you should try to face a corner or dead end so that the enemy Hero has nowhere to flee. If you
want to help your team with their aim, do not move a lot during the last second
so that it will be easier for them to guess where the enemy Hero will land.
While casting Gorge, Stitches gets some Unstoppable
frames that briefly make him immune to crowd control.
You may use this knowledge to your advantage in some rare scenarios (for example
against Chromie targeting you with Temporal Loop).

abilities.title: Shambling Horror
abilities.text:
Shambling Horror
(D)
Stitches
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to spread Vile Gas in a large area every second and prevent your Movement Speed from being reduced below 110% for 4 seconds.
Vile Gas
Hitting enemies with Basic Attacks or the inner area of Slam afflicts them with Vile Gas, dealing an additional 36 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Deals 150% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.
Shambling Horror is a Trait that passively applies Vile Gas
to enemies hit with Basic Attacks or with the inner area of Slam.
Vile Gas deals damage over time, increased against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.
You can activate Shambling Horror to spread Vile Gas around you
and briefly gain a small but useful amount of Movement Speed which cannot be reduced
by enemy debuffs. This effect can also be used right after
casting Gorge, to move faster towards allied Structures
and/or allied Heroes, especially if enemy Heroes applied a Slow
debuff on you right after you used Gorge.

talent_pages.text:

Cooldown: 8 seconds
Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.
Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.
Patchwork Creation is a strong Talent that
gives you Armor when applying Vile Gas,
doubled when Shambling Horror is active,
and increases all healing received by 15%.
The healing amplification provided empowers your self-healing
from Devour and the healing received
from Regeneration Globes as well, increasing your self-sustain
while laning regardless of your Healer
being good at single-target sustain healing or not. On the other hand,
the value you can get from Patchwork Creation
during team fights heavily depends on your Healer
because some of them (for example Uther) will not heal you that much.
Consider picking this Talent to increase your survivability against burst damage,
when playing on Maps where team fights last longer than usual, and when
the early game is important (for example Braxis Holdout)—because
in that case you will not be able to get enough value from Hungry for More.
You can combine this Talent with Vile Cleaver at Level 4
to drastically increase the amount of Armor you will get
when hitting multiple enemies with Slam
and then activating Shambling Horror if needed.
This effect is particularly effective when fighting near Minions in lane
or when contesting an Objective featuring
multiple Monsters (notably Shrines on Infernal Shrines).

Stitches
Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Devour increases Stitches' Health Regeneration by 1.5 and the damage of Vile Gas by 2%, stacking up to 100 times.
Savor The Flavor is a weak Quest-based Talent that,
when using Devour on enemy Heroes, permanently
increases Stitches's Health Regeneration and Vile Gas's damage by a small amount.
We do not recommend this Talent because, compared to the other options in the same Tier,
it does not provide enough value while also forcing you to use Devour
on enemy Heroes in situations when you may prefer to safely use it on nearby Minions instead
and to use it on cooldown in moments when you may prefer holding it in case a team fight happens.
✔
Hungry for More
(Level 1)
Stitches
Gain 5% Movement Speed.
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25.
Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.
Hungry for More is a good Quest-based Talent that
increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25 (not scaling) for each Regeneration Globe collected
and his Movement Speed by 5% baseline and by additional 5% every 20 Regeneration Globes collected.
You can easily get a good amount of bonus maximum Health out of this Talent,
especially on 3-lane Maps where you can rotate between lanes
(such as Tomb of the Spider Queen) together with your team.
Considering that collecting 30 Regeneration Globes during a balanced game is not that easy,
do not expect to get more than 750 bonus maximum Health (about 10% extra maximum Health at Level 20)
and 10% additional Movement Speed from this Talent in most of your games.
This is the go-to Talent when planning to pick Gorge later on
because it gives you much needed Movement Speed for running away right after using it.
Similarly, it should be avoided when you are going to pick Putrid Bile
because the Movement Speed provided by them will not stack.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
?
Playtime!
(Level 4)
Stitches
Basic Attacks restore 5 Mana and reduce Slam's cooldown by 0.75 seconds.
For each enemy Hero hit by Slam's inner area, restore 5 Mana and reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.
Playtime! is a good Talent allows Stitches to restore Mana
when hitting enemies with Basic Attacks and reduce the cooldown of Slam
when hitting enemy Heroes with the inner area of Slam or enemies with Basic Attacks.
The cooldown reduction provided helps you when clearing Minions and has moderate synergy with Slam-based Talents:
Under Pressure at Level 13 and Pulverize at Level 16.
You can even pick Chop Chop at Level 13 to boost your Attack Speed
and get more cooldown reduction by a consequence.
?
Vile Cleaver
(Level 4)
Stitches
Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies.
Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.
Vile Cleaver is a good Talent that increases your Attack Damage
against enemies affected by Vile Gas and makes Vile Gas spread to nearby enemies
and makes Slam applies Vile Gas to all enemies hit.
The ability to easily spread Vile Gas provided by Vile Cleaver
has synergy with Patchwork Creation at Level 1,
Putrefaction at Level 7,
and Under Pressure at Level 13.
✔
Tenderizer
(Level 4)
Stitches
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.
Tenderizer is a good Talent that applies
a decent Slow to enemies hit with Basic Attacks
and heals Stitches for a small portion of his maximum Health.
While not particularly powerful, we recommend this Talent because
it helps you body block enemy Heroes and
slightly mitigates the lack of crowd control
suffered by Stitches when Putrid Bile is not available.
The healing provided by this Talent has synergy with
Patchwork Creation at Level 1 because it amplifies any healing effect
or with Hungry for More at Level 1 because it increases your maximum Health.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
✔
Serrated Edge
(Level 7)
Stitches
Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.
Serrated Edge is a good Talent that makes
Hook deal percent-based damage
to enemy Heroes and slightly reduce its cooldown when connecting on them.
You also get some Mana in the process, to compensate for the cooldown reduction.
The main reason to ever pick this Talent is the moderate amount damage it deals
because the cooldown reduction happens only if Hook hits an enemy Hero
and therefore it does not help you to get another try sooner than usual when missing.
?
Second Helping
(Level 7)
Stitches
Devour gains 1 additional charge with a 6 second cooldown between uses.
Gambit: If Stitches is at max Health after using Devour, he gains a Shield equal to 15% of his maximum Health for 10 seconds. Every death, reduce this Shield by 3%.
Second Helping is a good Talent that gives you
another charge of Devour,
but with a 6-second cooldown between uses. Whenever he will end up being
at maximum Health after using Devour to heal,
Stitches will get a temporary Shield equal to a percentage of his maximum Health,
losing effectiveness death after death due to the Gambit mechanic.
Patchwork Creation at Level 1 can increase
the healing provided by this Talent like any other healing effect
and, due to being based on Stitches's maximum Health,
it also has synergy with Hungry for More
and similar effects that increase it.
Having a second Devour
at your disposal greatly increases your survivability. While the Shield is welcome,
this Talent does not become bad after losing most if not all its Gambit stacks,
especially if you pick Digestive Juices at Level 16.
?
Putrefaction
(Level 7)
Stitches
While Shambling Horror is active, Vile Gas reduces healing received by 40%.
Passive: Vile Gas heals Stitches for 75% of the damage dealt.
Putrefaction is a good Talent that allows Stitches
to reduce the healing received by enemy Heroes affected by Vile Gas,
but only while Shambling Horror is active.
In addition to that, Vile Gas heals Stitches for a big portion of its damage dealt.
The ability to reduce healing is interesting to have on a Hero
whose playstyle revolves around picking off enemy Heroes with Hook
and burst them down.
You may need this Talent against team compositions that feature
a high amount of healing (for example Whitemane)
or self-healing (such as Arthas).

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Putrid Bile
(Level 10)
Stitches
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 75 seconds
Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.
Putrid Bile is a good Heroic Ability
that helps a lot when your team needs additional peeling
from low-mobility Heroes.
✔
Gorge
(Level 10)
Stitches
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 65 seconds
Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.
Gorge is a good Heroic Ability that can be used to either
transform your Hook into a better engage
against low-mobility Heroes, especially near allied Structures,
or to remove an enemy Hero from the battle and gain a numerical advantage for a few seconds.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
✔
Meat Hook
(Level 13)
Stitches
Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.
Meat Hook is a good Talent that,
after hitting an enemy Hero with Hook,
heals Stitches by a huge chunk of his maximum Health over a few seconds.
The healing effect can be refreshed with Basic Attacks on that Hero.
Consider picking this Talent when you want to boost your survivability,
however, keep in mid that its effect is reliant on connecting Hook
and it is weak to healing reduction effects (such as
Emerald by Deckard Cain).
✘
Under Pressure
(Level 13)
Stitches
Increase Slam's damage by 25.
Quest: After damaging Heroes with Vile Gas 6 times, permanently increase the damage of Slam by 1, to a maximum of 75 additional damage.
Under Pressure is a weak Talent that slightly
increases the damage you deal with Slam
and further increases it when you damage enemy Heroes with Vile Gas,
up to 100 additional damage with the outer area of Slam
and up to 150 additional damage with the inner area of Slam.
We do not recommend this Talent because getting stacks is not that easy
and the damage provided by each stack is not that good,
therefore it takes too much time to get a reasonable amount of damage from it.
?
Chop Chop
(Level 13)
Stitches
Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror grants 40% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration of this effect.
Chop Chop is a decent Talent that increases Stitches's Attack Speed
for a few seconds after hitting enemy Heroes with Hook
or after activating Shambling Horror.
Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh the duration.
Consider picking this Talent when you want to improve your damage output,
especially if you have Tenderizer at Level 4
to Slow enemy Heroes hit with your Basic Attacks.
Blinds will reduce the effectiveness of this Talent.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
✔
Pulverize
(Level 16)
Stitches
All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.
Pulverize is a strong Talent that
drastically Slows all enemy hit by Slam for almost a second
and slightly lowers their Armor for a short duration,
regardless of them being hit by its inner or outer area.
Reducing the Armor of enemy Heroes, even if not by a lot,
increases your own damage and the damage done by the rest of your team,
something that is quite useful if you are playing around Hook.
The extra Slow improves your otherwise lacking
peeling capabilities as well as your engage potential
as it can be used to setup enemy Heroes for your team,
especially if they rely on skillshot-based Abilities to deal damage.
You can even use the extra Slow for increasing your chances to land an Hook.
?
Digestive Juices
(Level 16)
Stitches
Devour deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. When used on a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds and causes the Hero hit to deal 50% reduced damage for 4 seconds.
Digestive Juices is a situational Talent
that halves the damage done by Heroes hit with Devour
for multiple seconds, other than reducing its cooldown and dealing additional damage over time.
Pick this Talent when you need additional peeling
against low-mobility melee Heroes only.
The short range of Devour makes this Talent
hard to use against Heroes who can play from the distance and
impossible to cast on enemy Heroes who have access
to mobility tools.
✘
Flare Up
(Level 16)
Stitches
Deals 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror increases this damage by 150% for 4 seconds.
Flare Up is a weak Talent that deals damage
to any enemy around Stitches. The damage per second goes up for 4 seconds
when Hook connects on an enemy Hero
or after activating Shambling Horror.
We do not recommend this Talent because missing Hook
will result in you not having a Talent for a dozen of seconds and because
you can boost your damage by going for the more reliant Pulverize instead.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Stitches
talent_pages.text:
?
Gift From The Embalmer
(Level 20)
Stitches
Putrid Bile deals 100% more damage to Heroes.
Quest: Each time Putrid Bile damages an enemy Hero, the duration of Stitches' next death timer is reduced by 2%, to a maximum of 80% total reduction. All stacks of this effect are lost upon death.
Gift From The Embalmer is a good Talent that greatly increases the damage of
Putrid Bile against Heroes and reduces your death timer
based on how many times you hit enemy Heroes with it.
Pick this Talent when you want to improve your damage output
without relying on Hook, something that is particularly
useful against dive compositions
that will come towards you and your team.
?
Hungry Hungry Stitches
(Level 20)
Stitches
For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.
Hungry Hungry Stitches is a situational Talent that
allows Stitches to use Gorge multiple times in a row
across 4 seconds. After that, enemy Heroes get released in the same order
they have been Gorged. Heroes released are massively Slowed for a second.
Stitches will have access to a short-range teleport
for each activation except the first one. Each enemy Hero will be released 4 seconds
after being Gorged, so they will come out at different times.
You can use this Talent to prolong the duration of your team's numerical advantage
or to setup a wombo combo,
especially if you can release enemy Heroes near impassable terrain
to further limit their movements.
✔
Master Hooker
(Level 20)
Stitches
Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.
Master Hooker is a strong Talent which provides 3 benefits:
redues the cooldown of Hook by 5 seconds,
greatly reduces the healing received by enemy Heroes hit by Hook for 2 seconds,
and gives the Unkillable buff to allied Heroes hit by Helping Hand for 2 seconds.
The cooldown reduction helps you when Hook misses
and has synergy with Hook-based Talents: Serrated Edge at Level 7,
Meat Hook or Chop Chop at Level 13,
and Flare Up at Level 16.
?
Gas Bag
(Level 20)
Stitches
Activating Shambling Horror grants Unstoppable for 3 seconds.
Passive: Shambling Horror's cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.
Gas Bag is a situational Talent that
reduces the cooldown of Shambling Horror
and makes it give Unstoppable when used.
Activating it at the right moment is crucial for surviving against some
burst compositions who will just take down
the first enemy they see, no matter if they have a lot of maximum Health or not.
